body:
Spec: docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md section 13 (Configuration) and section 15 rows R1 and R4. This is the operator-owned prerequisite of both the fleet-extensions ticket and the @adlc/autopilot build ticket (DAG edges from this ticket to both).

=== CONTEXT ===
.adlc/config.json does not exist in this repo. It is an IMMUTABLE TRUST ROOT (packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/trust-roots.mjs DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE_TRUST_ROOTS), so rails-guard-ci will report the addition as a trust-root change. The #141 ceremony requires a non-author CODEOWNER approval, and this repository has exactly one CODEOWNER, so the ceremony is unsatisfiable as written; the plan (spec section 0, decision 12) is a one-time admin merge carrying the trust-root-change label, and rails-guard reporting the trust-root addition on that PR is the expected record of the ceremony.

=== TASK ===
1. Author .adlc/config.json with exactly the section-13 content: the fleet block (gate.build, gate.test, init 'npm ci --ignore-scripts', concurrency 1, base main, timeoutMinutes 30, prosecuteFailOn medium, reviewProvider codex, reviewMaxBytes 262144, allowedCommands), the autopilot block (restMinutes 10, maxOpenPrs 5, maxRounds 15, wallClockMinutes 90, ciFixRounds 2, ciWatchMinutes 30, reviewMaxBytes 262144, repo 'voodootikigod/adlc', protectedPathsExtra []), and a ticketSync block with provider github and select (no query key, or a string). NO operator-local keys (quotaThreshold, quotaReserve, adapter, model) may appear.
2. Open the PR with the trust-root-change label; the admin CODEOWNER merges it deliberately after rails-guard reports the trust-root addition.
3. After merge, prove fleet is runnable here (spec R4).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
AC1. The file parses and matches section 13 key-for-key (no extra keys, no operator-local keys). VERIFY: node -e "const c=require('./.adlc/config.json'); for (const k of ['quotaThreshold','quotaReserve','adapter','model','adapterCommand']) if (k in (c.fleet||{}) || k in (c.autopilot||{})) process.exit(2); console.log('ok')" exit code 0.
AC2. fleet loads the block without SECURITY warnings. VERIFY: adlc fleet run --dry-run --json 2>stderr.txt exit code 0 AND grep -c SECURITY stderr.txt prints 0.
AC3. The trust-root ceremony is visible in the PR: the PR carries the trust-root-change label and the rails-guard job output names .adlc/config.json as the trust-root path. VERIFY: gh pr view <n> --json labels shows trust-root-change; the rails-guard job log contains '.adlc/config.json'.
AC4. Existing tests are unaffected. VERIFY: npm test exit code 0 on the PR.
AC5. The ticketSync block validates against packages/ticket-sync/schemas/adlc-config.schema.json. VERIFY: adlc ticket-sync doctor --json exit code 0 (or the equivalent schema check in packages/ticket-sync/test/), and a copy of the block with query set to null fails that validator.

=== NOT IN SCOPE ===
Any fleet or autopilot code; plugin reinstall (R2 is machine-local and preflight-gated); the live canary (build ticket AC10).
title: Land .adlc/config.json (fleet + autopilot + ticketSync blocks) via the admin trust-root ceremony; prove fleet dry-run in this repo
